'''Aleos Narek''' was the brother of [[Var Narek]]. [[Gender|He]] had a [[Narek family|family]], and a [[Aleos Narek's shop|store]]. He was [[Death|killed]] in the [[Bombing of Rialla Way]], along with the store and the rest of his family, minus [[Var Narek's father]], and his brother.<ref name="Onslaught" />
